items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: It’s what Ellington made remarks on one time or another.

ctx.x: You know Aaron Copland was asked to judge a contest of twentieth century music one day. And they asked him they said, “What do you think of most of the scores that come in from the competition?” He says, “Very little of it sings or dances.” I think that’s what you’re trying to say. It’s gotta sing, it’s got to dance.
Yeah, that’s right. It’s what Ellington made remarks on one time or another.
